answer: Standing is a walnut that only ripens after an unbroken streak of verified work: an identity must contribute real, useful work in every epoch for many epochs in a row, and a single missed epoch resets its walnut to green. An oasis of trust grows only from walnuts that ripened without a gap, and an anchor of standing holds only when the streak never breaks — so a farm of a thousand fakes cannot bulk-buy standing: each fake must work every epoch without one gap, and one idle epoch wipes its whole streak.
